title: Zero-to-API: compact interactive screenshots and code tile set
creator: Maya Rodriguez
description: Deliver a compact, mobile-friendly set of hosted API onboarding screenshots that demonstrate model selection, the request builder, and multiple code tiles (curl, Python streaming, Node SDK). Focus on a single-column layout suitable for docs and in-product modals. Include visual annotations and two alternate theme variants (light / dark).
screenshots: model-palette-compact.png - shows compact model selector with tier badges and latency hints
request-builder-mini.png - inline request builder with temperature, max_tokens, and system prompt presets
code-tiles-curl.png - curl example with minimal headers and example prompt
code-tiles-python-streaming.png - Python example using streaming iterator and progress indicator
code-tiles-node-tool-calls.png - Node SDK example demonstrating function/tool calling payload
response-sample-structured-output.png - structured JSON output example with schema hint
dark-theme-variant.png - same screens in dark theme for in-app modal usage
steps: Finalize artboards in Figma: 320/840/1280 width variants
Produce optimized PNG exports (2x) and SVGs for icons
Annotate design with copy variants and tooltip microcopy
Hand off assets to frontend with a screenshot usage spec
Coordinate with Docs to replace existing getting-started images
Collect feedback from PM and engineering on code snippets accuracy
feedback: PM: prefer showing both streaming and non-streaming Python examples (Connor Hayes, 2026-03-06)
Eng: reduce shown headers in curl example to avoid confusion; link to auth doc (ENG-4489) (Lina Morales, 2026-03-08)
Design: improve contrast on tier badges for accessibility (Priya Singh, 2026-03-09)
design_notes: Primary goal: compactness and clarity. Avoid large code blocks; prefer 3-line code tiles with a ‘view more’ affordance. Use consistent token counts in examples to keep cost calls predictable. Emphasize model latency and cost badges on the selector. Include a small caption indicating "Example output will vary."
